title: Partial sums of random multiplicative functions with supercritical divisor twists
summary: Let $f$ be a Steinhaus random multiplicative function, and for $α\in \mathbb{R}$, let $d_α$ denote the $α$-divisor function. For $α\in (1,2)$ we establish that $$ \mathbb{E}\bigg\{\Big|\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\sum_{n\leq x} d_α(n)f(n)\Big|^{2q}\bigg\} \ll \frac{(\log x)^{2q(α-1)}}{(\log\log x)^{3αq/2}(1-αq)+1} $$ uniformly for $q\in [0,1/α]$ and all large $x$. This matches predictions from the theory of supercritical Gaussian multiplicative chaos, and provides an analogue of a seminal result of Harper corresponding to the critical ($α=1$) case.
